description: One agent credit line (account) or the lines a wallet owns (owner: five a call, newest first; page 2 for the next five): its market, credits posted, USDG owed, LTV against its target, trigger and LLTV, a health word, what the agent can still borrow, the daily limit and what went out and is left of it today, the price at which it can be liquidated, its agent, keeper, owner, allowlist and sale settings, the agent's gas station and whether it is allowlisted, USDG it holds, and whether protect would act now. holder: what holding $BORRO gets this line (Hold $BORRO. Borrow for less.): up to half its interest back every Monday, what Borro's keeper makes if it liquidates the line unless it was left short or left bad debt, and where switched on gas on the house; counts (Borro's keeper counted it on the last day it counted), share, via (owner or agent: whichever has the larger share), heldBorro (wallet plus own lock), borroForFull ($BORRO for the full rate at today's price), weekSoFarUsdg, interestBackBps (the part of the line's interest that would come back, up to 5000; share and interestBackBps are estimates if held through a whole UTC day) and gasOnTheHouse (only where switched on, and only for a counted line owing gas.minDebtUsdg, 25 USDG by default, or more whose holder holds at least gas.minShare, half by default, of the $BORRO its lines' full rate needs, within weekly limits); live false until Borro's keeper publishes its count.

owner.description: A wallet whose lines to list

page.description: With owner: which five lines, newest first (default 1)
